prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: first-person point-and-click castle exploration game background. Generate ONE full-bleed landscape 1536x1024 image, 3:2. Fine realistic painted environmental concept art of the SAME inhabited medium-sized western fantasy lord's castle, with crisp legible architectural edges and rich but natural material textures. Pale warm-gray limestone ashlar, restrained pointed stone arches, textured dark oak, small aged bronze fittings, muted wine-red textiles where appropriate. Believable well-maintained castle proportions and rigid coherent perspective, refined but modest rather than a royal palace. Standing eye-level camera with natural wide field of view, foreground and middle-distance depth. Soft cool daylight balanced by restrained warm household light where appropriate, calm inhabited atmosphere. No people, readable text, signage, emblems, UI, navigation arrows, hotspot outlines, return-button graphic, watermark, collage, modern objects, excessive bloom or magical effects. The picture must be a finished game environment, not a map or cutaway.
Scene: the castle's UNDERGROUND STORAGE CELLAR beneath the service wing, a grounded quietly atmospheric wine-and-provision cellar. The camera stands at the foot of the enclosed descending stone stair from the kitchen, AFTER its bend; the stair and kitchen entrance are BEHIND the viewer and out of frame. This is a final room on a branch: NO visible onward doors, corridors, archway exits, trapdoors or secret passages. All structural arches are solid wall bays or shallow recesses, not openings to additional rooms.
A comfortably broad stone cellar with believable low barrel vaults and load-bearing piers, pale gray limestone darkened gently by age, level flagstone floor and fine material detail. Along the LEFT and rear-left walls stand wooden wine barrels in sturdy horizontal oak racks, a few upright barrels and plain unmarked ceramic storage jars. Along the RIGHT wall are stout open oak shelves holding folded sacks, woven baskets, crockery and a few wooden produce crates. Keep a clean walkable central aisle and clear foreground floor; arrange objects as functional storage instead of a chaotic pile. A small wooden work surface to one side holds an unmarked ledger closed shut and a simple candle holder. No readable labels or symbols.
Lighting must remain legible and beautiful, not black horror lighting: a very small high-set barred ventilation window near ceiling level admits a narrow wash of cool daylight; two or three modest warm wall candles contribute amber reflected light and soft shadows, enough to read the stone vault, barrel curves and aisle. The warm-gray stone, worn oak and aged bronze belong to the same refined but practical castle kitchen. Calm dry cared-for cellar, tactile environmental painting. No prison cells, chains, torture equipment, skeletal remains, occult objects, magic, abandoned ruins, treasure hoard, underground river, modern wine labels, oversized cathedral vaults or extra visible doorway.
